tldr: Uranus in the 6th house: freedom becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With Uranus in the 6th house, this part of you awakens through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. Uranus describes freedom, disruption, originality, change, and the need to break from stale patterns. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. Uranus can become honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point.
gift: honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
